column2: For this one may be the reincarnation of the evil $$大邪神$$...
the $$救世主$$, after all!
Perhaps he is held back by the softhearted feeling that he cannot easily kill someone who claims to be his $$ご主人$$'s elder sister!
That must be the reason!
But more importantly, what say you?
Why not come with us and rescue this sister of yours?
Why not come with us and rescue this brother of yours?
After all, once we escape this prison, you will not live long in your present position either...
Then why not...
use us to save your own kin? That would be worthwhile too!
We, too, will add you to our $$戦力$$ and make full use of you. In other words, it is a bargain!
What say you? It is not a bad offer, is it?!
Are you... crying?
Though it was an $$事故$$, it seems we have made you an outlaw as well.
One who knows an act accords with their own $$正義$$, yet does not carry it out, is called a coward.
To know fear...
To know fear, and yet not be afraid of it—that is
a true hero!
That is an ancient $$邪教の教え$$! Then here is another!
Courage, thou art a friend! This is what makes both men and women most beautiful!
The courage you showed may be the true nature that changed your form!
